literal: Ignorance or great intimacy, thus let one understand, painful things friends if do.
translation: If friends do things that cause you pain, understand it as either their innocent ignorance or the privilege of great intimacy.
modern: நண்பர்கள் மனம் வருந்தத்தக்க செயல்களைச் செய்தால், அதனை அவர்களின் அறியாமை என்றோ அல்லது மிகுந்த உரிமையின் பாற்பட்டது என்றோ உணர்ந்துகொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet advises on how to handle hurtful actions from close friends. When friends do something that causes pain, one should not immediately become angry or break the friendship. Instead, one should attribute the action either to their innocent ignorance or to the deep intimacy that makes them feel entitled to act freely. By understanding it this way, the bond of friendship is preserved.
